rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is a mandatory join key and one-to-one identifier with no missing values allowed

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N serves as a one-to-one join key with Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N and must uniquely identify records; evidence shows one duplicate value '3'

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory account identifier with no missing values observed

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit numeric code
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit identifiers ranging from 1001-1028; stored as int64 but intended as string identifier

rule: Account_No must be unique across all records
rationale: Account numbers should uniquely identify accounts; evidence shows duplicates for values 1001 and 1010

rule: Full_Name must not be null
rationale: Full_Name is a mandatory personal identifier with 100% population

rule: Full_Name words (excluding particles bin, binte, s/o, d/o) must be Title Case (not lowercase start or ALL CAPS)
rationale: Names contain casing inconsistencies like 'junrong', 'irfan', 'Hui Min tan' that should be standardized to Title Case; particles should be ignored

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() if w else False) or (w.isupper() and w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','s/o','d/o')) for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','s/o','d/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Full_Name must not contain consecutive whitespace characters
rationale: Evidence shows extra whitespace in 'Ramesh s/o  Govindasamy' (double space) that should be removed

rule: ID must not be null
rationale: ID is a mandatory government identifier (Singapore NRIC/FIN) with 100% population

rule: ID must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one checksum letter
rationale: Standard Singapore ID format is 9 characters (e.g., S1234567D); evidence shows malformed 7-character value 'S123456'

rule: JoinDate must not be null
rationale: JoinDate is a mandatory temporal field with 1 missing value (3.3%) observed that requires correction

rule: JoinDate must be a parseable datetime string
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as datetime64[ns]; contains invalid date '2025-13-01' (month 13 does not exist)

rule: JoinDate must not be in the future
rationale: JoinDate represents historical account creation dates; future date '2027-01-15' indicates data entry error

rule: LastLogin must be a parseable datetime string
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as datetime64[ns]; all values should be valid timestamps

rule: LastLogin must not be in the future
rationale: LastLogin represents historical user activity and should not exceed current date

rule: Subscription_Type must not be null
rationale: Subscription_Type is a mandatory categorical field with 100% population

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium
rationale: Closed domain of 5 subscription tiers observed in the dataset

rule: SubscriptionFee must not be null
rationale: SubscriptionFee has 2 missing values (6.7%) that require clarification or imputation

rule: SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value
rationale: Column is stored as string but intended as float64; contains non-numeric text value 'free'

rule: SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel value 99999
rationale: Value 99999 appears to be a sentinel for missing or invalid subscription fees

rule: SubscriptionFee must be non-negative (>= 0)
rationale: Subscription fees represent monetary amounts that should not be negative

rule: Status must not be null
rationale: Status is a mandatory boolean indicator with 100% population

rule: Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
rationale: Boolean field stored as string with 6 observed distinct values representing true/false states

rule: AccountBalance must not contain sentinel value 99999.0
rationale: Value 99999.0 appears to be a sentinel for missing or invalid account balances

rule: AccountBalance must not be negative
rationale: AccountBalance shows predominantly positive values; negative value -150.5 requires confirmation as valid overdraft or error

rule: PreferredLanguage must not be null
rationale: PreferredLanguage is a mandatory categorical field with 100% population

rule: PreferredLanguage must be one of: English, French, German, Malay, Tamil
rationale: Closed domain of 5 official languages observed in the dataset

rule: Device must not be null
rationale: Device is a mandatory categorical field with 100% population

rule: Device must be one of: Desktop, Mobile, Tablet
rationale: Closed domain of 3 device types observed in the dataset

rule: OS must not be null
rationale: OS is a mandatory categorical field with 100% population

rule: OS must be one of the canonical values: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS
rationale: Operating system names must use official brand casing; flag variants like 'android', 'IOS', 'LINUX', 'macOs'

rule: FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Feedback scores appear to be on a 1-5 scale consistent with FeedbackScore1; value 7.3 is an outlier exceeding this domain

rule: FeedbackScore must not contain sentinel value 7.3
rationale: Value 7.3 appears to be a sentinel for missing or invalid feedback scores, lying outside the expected 1-5 range

rule: FeedbackScore1 must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: FeedbackScore1 represents ratings on a 1-5 scale with maximum observed value 5.0

rule: JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin
rationale: Account join date should precede or equal the last login date; violations (e.g., JoinDate 2020-11-02 but LastLogin 2019-01-01) indicate temporal inconsistency

rule: If SubscriptionFee is the text 'free', then Subscription_Type must be 'Free'
rationale: The string 'free' in the fee column should correspond to the 'Free' subscription tier; mismatches indicate data inconsistency

rule: Every S_N in Acc_Info_dirty must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N (one-to-one key consistency)
rationale: S_N is designated as a one-to-one shared key with Cust_Bio_dirty; all values must have corresponding matches in the sibling table

check_params.semantic_check: Record must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty (Name should be retrievable by S_N)

rule: Full_Name must match Cust_Bio_dirty.Name when joined on S_N (accounting for case and whitespace differences)
rationale: Full_Name and Name represent the same person attribute across tables; inconsistencies like 'Wang Shi Jie' vs 'WANG SHI JIE' should be flagged for standardization

check_params.semantic_check: Full_Name must match Name (ignoring case and extra whitespace)

rule: ID must match Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No when joined on S_N
rationale: ID and ID_No represent the same government identifier across tables; mismatches indicate data linkage errors

rule: Gender from Cust_Bio_dirty must be 'Male' if Full_Name contains 'Bin' or 's/o', and 'Female' if Full_Name contains 'Binte' or 'd/o'
rationale: Malay and Indian naming conventions use patronymic particles that encode gender: Bin/s/o indicate Male, Binte/d/o indicate Female; mismatches suggest data errors

check_params.semantic_check: Gender must be 'Male' when Full_Name contains 'Bin' or 's/o', and 'Female' when containing 'Binte' or 'd/o'
